fields.statement: QA cycle 3 with the built binary (359e3c1) in a scratch repo, with a fake rex that logs every call and runs only the daemon's own `rhiza run start|resume` tab command (agent tabs only logged): a daemon held the lock; `rhiza daemon --once` from the repo's run worktree (repo.built) exited 2 with 'another daemon holds the lock: process Mac.localdomain:88034'; after kill -9 of a running daemon, status said not running and a new `rhiza daemon --once` took the lock and ran.

QA cycle 3 with the built binary (359e3c1) in a scratch repo, with a fake rex that logs every call and runs only the daemon's own `rhiza run start|resume` tab command (agent tabs only logged): one accepted milestone change set with a leaf was started once (one 'run start <id>' tab); a change set whose run start failed before journaling (its worktree path blocked: exit 3) got exactly one tab over an 85s daemon, and daemon status listed it under 'Not journaled' in text and --json; with a run of A live and an interrupted one, the next accepted change set was still started (interrupted takes no slot).

QA cycle 3 with the built binary (359e3c1) in a scratch repo, with a fake rex that logs every call and runs only the daemon's own `rhiza run start|resume` tab command (agent tabs only logged): `rhiza daemon --once` without --permission-mode exited 2 before any tab; with --permission-mode manual the tab ran '<rhiza> run start <cs id> --permission-mode manual', which passed run start, journaled and reached build/build; with --autonomous the command was 'run start 01M62CZE11ZQDW7E1N866YV325 --permission-mode manual --autonomous'.

QA cycle 3 with the built binary (359e3c1) in a scratch repo, with a fake rex that logs every call and runs only the daemon's own `rhiza run start|resume` tab command (agent tabs only logged): killed a daemon-started run with kill -9; the next `rhiza daemon --once` opened one tab running 'run resume <run>', journaled daemon-resumed and the run continued build/build; a poll while it ran opened no tab; after killing it again a poll opened no tab, daemon-resumed stayed at 1, and `rhiza run start` refused the change set naming the live run.

QA cycle 3 with the built binary (359e3c1) in a scratch repo, with a fake rex that logs every call and runs only the daemon's own `rhiza run start|resume` tab command (agent tabs only logged): `rhiza daemon status` said 'Daemon not running' before any daemon; while one ran it named its process; after runs it listed Live runs (interrupted / running with change sets), Last started, Last resumed and Not journaled, and --json carried the same fields; after kill -9 of the daemon it said not running.

QA cycle 3 with the built binary (359e3c1) in a scratch repo, with a fake rex that logs every call and runs only the daemon's own `rhiza run start|resume` tab command (agent tabs only logged): the run journal of a started run had a process entry with host Mac.localdomain and pid 81153, the resumed run another with pid 86523; with each pid killed the daemon and daemon status reported the run interrupted, and with it alive running.
